name: @dsh-external/project-nav
description: DSH plugin: anti-drift project governance — bidirectional feature<->file mapping, mainline vector, and a governance-first action ledger (plan/begin/done). v0.3.0: multi-session concurrency — scope locks instead of a global single-in_progress rule (disjoint scopes run in PARALLEL, overlapping ones QUEUE via wait=true), self-healing leases, and a cross-process ledger lock so concurrent planners never lose an action. v0.4.0: scope fingerprints — nav_mark begin records size/mtime/sha1 of every file in scope, nav_mark done reports DRIFT when a file changed or vanished WHILE the action ran, and nav_status shows live drift for running actions.
author: Fishsb (lk)
